name: Spellfire Adept

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/frhof/character-options.

summary: Once per turn, when your spell deals Radiant damage, roll and spend up to two Hit Dice and add them to one damage roll. Your Radiant damage ignores Resistance.

benefits.name: Spellfire Surge
benefits.summary: Once per turn, when your spell deals Radiant damage, roll and spend up to two Hit Dice and add them to one damage roll.
benefits.text: Once per turn, when a spell you cast deals Radiant damage, you can roll up to two of your unused Hit Dice, spending them, and add the total to one of its damage rolls. In a fight it spends two (the largest first) unless you turn it Off in the class tab.

benefits.name: Searing Radiance
benefits.text: Radiant damage you deal ignores Resistance.

prerequisites.text: Level 4+, Spellfire Spark or the Spellcasting or Pact Magic feature
